All values are exactly representable for these inputs. C/Rust use fixed stack arrays that their compiler may eliminate; fwp uses ordinary Vec pipes and may allocate intermediates. No fast math or multiply-add contraction; optimization level 2. All validate output against raw interpretation. One warmup/RSS process precedes sixteen balanced rotating wall/child-CPU process samples including startup, construction, calculation, checked result conversion in fwp, and printing. C/Rust conversion is valid for these known inputs but does not implement general optional conversion. Compilation and profiles are separate. fwp counts managed requests/retains/charged storage, excluding initial constants, both with normal collection and disabled collection. C has no explicit heap allocation; Rust verifies no allocator calls during the calculation. Reference counts exclude startup/printing allocator internals; declared stack-array bytes are source storage, not measured frame size. Full generated code/disassembly, commands and hashes are retained; no SIMD instruction, zero-cost or parity claim follows from the API.
